svg.title: JGDMS proxy trust pipeline — ProxyCodebaseSPI, Bytecode Analysis Engine, and VerdictRegistry
svg.desc: Structural diagram showing how a remote proxy codebase URL flows through ProxyCodebaseSPI interception, bytecode analysis in an SELinux-isolated process, VerdictRegistry verdict lookup and storage, and finally into LoadClassPermission policy enforcement before the JVM loads the class. The bytecode analysis engine classifies each JAR as SAFE, INCONCLUSIVE, or DANGEROUS. A DANGEROUS verdict is issued for blocking static initialisers (BLOCKING or BLOCKING_DECLARED), circular static-initialiser dependencies (CYCLE), and AtomicSerial protocol violations. BLOCKING_DECLARED is raised when a JAR's PERMISSIONS.LIST declares a permission that guards a known blocking I/O call in a static initialiser — granting that permission makes virtual-thread carrier pinning reachable from class loading, which is a Denial of Service risk. Administrators must not grant permissions that correspond to a BLOCKING_DECLARED verdict.

g.text: Remote service (untrusted source)
Publishes proxy codebase URL via JGDMS lookup / JERI unmarshalling
ProxyCodebaseSPI
Intercepts codebase URL before unmarshalling begins
RFC 3986 URL validation · URLPermission whitelist check · hand-off to registry
VerdictRegistry
Keyed by JAR content hash (not URL) · stores per-class analysis verdicts
ALLOW · DENY · WARN (clinit-blocks) · PENDING (submit for analysis)
Persisted · distributed · signed by analysis service key
Reject
Bytecode Analysis Engine (isolated process)
Parses bytecode as data only — never loads / executes classes
ASM non-classloading · call-graph BFS from <clinit> · blocking-sink registry
Circular <clinit> dependency detection · native-method opacity registry
Produces signed verdict per class: ALLOW · WARN · DENY
DirtyChai policy enforcement
LoadClassPermission · SerialObjectPermission · ConcurrentPolicyFile
Verdict fed into policy grant: WARN → restricted thread context · DENY → no grant
ALLOW verdict required before grant is written by PolicyWriter
JVM class loading (DirtyChai SecureClassLoader)
LoadClassPermission checked · CodeSource verified · ProtectionDomain assigned
Virtual thread carrier pool
Class loading proceeds — carrier pinning risk eliminated by pre-analysis
JFR feedback → refine blocking-sink registry in analysis engine
